scope:
Extract all printed base-class spell lists without spell-record lookups.

The PDF's captions, painted cells and continuation headers supply all seventy
tables and their literal names, schools and C/R/M flags. Spell header class
labels are separate source statements and never override these tables.

tables.caption: Cantrips (Level 0 Bard Spells)
intro: This section presents the Bard spell list. The spells are organized by spell level and then alphabetized, and each spell’s school of magic is listed. In the Special column, C means the spell requires Concentration, R means it’s a Ritual, and M means it requires a specific Material component.
